title: Weapons you can bring
summary: Fighting back in R.E.P.O. is optional but possible: the game defines a gun, a melee weapon, a laser variant and bullets as separate objects.
body: A gun is an item like any other, which means it takes up the same carrying attention as the loot you came for.
Melee is handled as its own weapon object rather than a property of the player, so you either have it or you do not.
There is more than one gun variant: the game also defines a laser weapon and bullets as their own objects.
What this entry does not tell you: damage, ammunition counts, reload times or how much a weapon costs. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: A gun is a defined item in the game.
Melee fighting uses its own weapon object.
Bullets are their own object rather than a hidden counter.
